svg.aria-label: The page cache: file reads go through the kernel's cache in RAM; a hit returns at memory speed, a miss reads from disk and keeps the page. Writes only dirty pages in the cache and are flushed to disk later. Unused RAM is used as cache, so free memory looks low on a healthy server.
svg.title: The page cache: file reads go through the kernel's cache in RAM; a hit returns at memory speed, a miss reads from disk and keeps the page. Writes only dirty pages in the cache and are flushed to disk later. Unused RAM is used as cache, so free memory looks low on a healthy server.
svg.text: hit: memory speed, no disk I/O
"free" memory low = RAM working as cache
